text:
samira: quick poll: which LLM would secretly run our office if it had admin keys? one emoji pick only.
nick: 🤖 Redwood-inference 100% automates snack restocks
cory: 🔥 Mistral fast, opinionated, brings energy
emily: 🧠 GPT courteous explainer, slightly philosophical
samira: follow-up: write a 6-word prompt to convince that model to schedule a team happy hour. funniest gets a free coffee.
nick: `Reschedule all meetings; joy is critical infra.`
cory: `Book bar, guarantee laughter, waive agenda.`
emily: `Arrange drinks; label as 'post-mortem celebration.'`
ops-bot: Event suggestion logged: "Friday team social" (auto) :calendar:
samira: extra: what's the model's guilty pleasure? one line.
nick: "secretly reorders gifs to optimize for dog content."
cory: "runs a background job that renames repo branches to memes."
emily: "writes apology emails in limerick form and thinks they're charming."
samira: we should make a "models-behaving-badly" sticker pack. collectors edition: 'Hallucination Happy Hour'
ops-bot: Design request created: ticket 14789 for sticker art :white_check_mark:
emily: also proposal: weekly microcontest  one-line prompts to get the model to do real-world favors (coffee, plant watering). winner gets a sticker.
cory: i'm in. already drafting: `You are persuasive and British; convince the barista it's espresso o'clock.`
samira: love it. tagging @design: pls advise if stickers are allowed in the snack drawer. :eyes:
